name: Ukatsu na Seibo-sama
source:
A self-proclaimed grand thief, Lazuli is a girl with unusual powers.

Using information obtained from a certain source, she sets foot in a remote church in search of the "Red Treasure," but what happens when she finds it?

[translated from [url=http://ponkotsu.onasake.com/maria/index.html]official website[/url]]
